Northern Irish specialist lands Edgbaston M&E package

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:56
Instaread

04 Aug 2026 By Harmsworth

Kane Group has secured a multimillion-pound mechanical and electrical (M&E) package on Sisk’s £42m redevelopment of Edgbaston Stadium in Birmingham.

The Northern Ireland-based specialist said it will deliver the full M&E installation for a 146-bedroom Radisson RED hotel and the redevelopment of an existing stadium stand.

It did not disclose the exact value of the M&E subcontract but said it was worth millions of pounds.

Main contractor Sisk was appointed in March by Warwickshire County Cricket Club.

The project will replace the Raglan and Priory stands with a 3,200-seat stand containing upgraded spectator facilities, in time for the 2027 Ashes series between England and Australia.

Work will also include hospitality boxes and hotel rooms overlooking the pitch.

At the time of its appointment, Sisk said the stadium redevelopment was expected to create 134 permanent jobs.

Kane said it would use building information modelling, in-house engineering and offsite manufacturing to deliver the M&E package.

Major components will be manufactured offsite before installation to reduce waste, improve quality control and lower programme risk.

Kane said its offsite manufacturing approach would be supported by a 1,899 square metre extension to its production facilities.

The M&E subcontractor will carry out the work within the live sporting venue and will also provide design, engineering, commissioning and maintenance services.

Kane Group managing director Cathal McMullan said: “This award reflects the strength of our relationship with Sisk and confidence in Kane’s ability to deliver complex MEP solutions.”

The company reported revenue of £87.6m for the year to 31 March 2025, up by about one-third.

Pre-tax profit more than doubled to £4.2m over the same period.

Kane’s project portfolio includes Trinity by Breakthrough in Oxford and Claridge’s Hotel in London.

Source: Kane Group press release
